name: JE Roadmap Block
author: jeplugins

sections.description:
JE Roadmap Block is a Gutenberg block that helps you create beautiful product roadmaps for your WordPress website.

Perfect for:

  • SaaS Products – Show upcoming features to your customers
  • Startups – Communicate your product vision
  • Software Companies – Display development progress
  • Plugin/Theme Developers – Share your roadmap publicly
  • Project Management – Track project milestones

Features

  • 3 Beautiful Layouts – List, Cards, and Compact views
  • 3 Status Types – Planned, In Progress, and Done
  • Easy to Use – Native Gutenberg block editor experience
  • Fully Responsive – Looks great on all devices
  • Lightweight – No bloat, fast loading
  • Accessible – Built with accessibility in mind

Pro Features

Upgrade to JE Roadmap Block Pro for:

  • 6 Color Themes
  • Custom Colors
  • Progress Bar
  • Filter by Status
  • ETA Dates
  • Link URLs
  • Priority Support
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/je-roadmap-block, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Create or edit a page/post and search for “Roadmap” block.
  4. Add items to your roadmap and customize as needed.
